data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking is represented with appropriate charts.
Success rates are displayed using Chart.js visualizations.

features.title: Display Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to show various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown with a line chart.
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart.

features.title: Visualize 8-Stage Pipeline
features.description: Use Chart.js to display an 8-stage pipeline visualization.
acceptance_criteria: The pipeline is accurately represented in 8 stages.
Each stage is clearly labeled and visualized.
The visualization is interactive and informative.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: TDD compliance is visualized with a radar chart.
SOLID principles are represented accurately.
The radar chart is clear and informative.

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Show actual data from recent runs to demonstrate Artemis's effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics are included in the presentation.
Data is accurate and up-to-date.
Metrics effectively demonstrate Artemis's capabilities.

features.title: Showcase Artemis HERO Section
features.description: Present an introduction to Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: The HERO section clearly explains Artemis.
The section is visually engaging.
Key features of Artemis are highlighted.

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: The HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Integration across stages is represented with a pie chart.
The chart is clear and easy to understand.
Integration data is accurately depicted.

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with options for manual navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate through slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Design Professional Presentation
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: The presentation has a gradient background.
Transitions between slides are smooth.
The overall design is professional and visually appealing.
